served_syms_5_4.public_sentence: served_syms had never been scored against our pre-registered band -- an exploratory AUROC (0.669 file_hit / 0.723 func_hit) had been computed once in a prior review, on this same 92, without an operating point or a recorded orientation. Scored now under a named procedure, with the orientation fixed in advance as the raw value -- informed by that exploratory AUROC having already been seen, not blind (§5.4.3), it does not reach the band (false-warn <= 0.20 at miss-recall >= 0.50) on func_hit: AUROC 0.278 [0.177, 0.385] (§5.2 rung: does_not_meet_opposite_direction), and no threshold clears both floors together.
